description: This file contains a Smarty plugin defining the {html_checkboxes} function, which generates HTML checkbox input elements based on provided parameters. It includes functions for rendering checkboxes and handling their output, with support for options like labels, separators, and pre-selected values.

methods.name: smarty_function_html_checkboxes
methods.description: Generates a list of HTML checkboxes based on input parameters, handling options, values, and output formatting.

methods.name: smarty_function_html_checkboxes_output
methods.description: Creates the HTML for a single checkbox input element, including label and separator, marking it as checked if applicable.
